pick.note: Channel is about 5 weeks old. 6 Shorts of ~110 seconds each: median 4.2M views, best 14.8M, healthy 3% like rate. Format: "What if you dropped X into the Cretaceous?" told in second person, with a conflict beat ("but there's a catch"). I found no direct copycats. The idea generalizes well beyond food (any object, animal or technology dropped into any era). Risk: very new, and ~110s of AI video per Short is heavy work.
